signature_alert.description: Unusually high forward packet rate detected.
Source IP scanned multiple destination ports.

analysis.incident_summary: High packet rate and port scan detected from internal host 192.168.0.109 to 192.168.0.111, all ports closed, likely reconnaissance activity.

traffic_analysis.packet_observation: High packet and forward rate, scanning all common ports, no service responses.

nmap_analysis.security_observation: All common ports closed, no open services detected, but scanning activity indicates reconnaissance; host may be protected by firewall or intentionally closed.

analysis.impact_analysis: Potential reconnaissance could lead to exploitation if vulnerabilities exist; no immediate compromise detected.
recommendations: Monitor source IP for repeated scans.
Implement rate limiting or IDS rules to mitigate scanning.
Enforce firewall rules to block repeated scans.
Conduct internal audit of network segmentation.
analysis.soc_conclusion: The activity is a typical internal reconnaissance scan with no evidence of exploitation. Continue monitoring and enforce network security controls.
